summary: Images supplied on 2026-11-12 of two marks the collection lacked: the PGE orange-outline mark (cropped from a Rapido Trains caboose announcement) and the British Columbia Railway dogwood mark. Other images supplied with them were recorded, not collected: J. F. Garden's book British Columbia Railway (cover), an embroidered British Columbia Railway patch, a stock photograph of a preserved green caboose (watermarked), a t-shirt print of the dogwood mark, and a decal sheet with the 1984–2004 BC Rail italic wordmark. The dogwood image first collected here was replaced on 2026-11-12 by the vector reconstruction in bc-railway-dogwood-vector-2026-11-12.

assets.label: PGE in an orange outline of the province
assets.sourceLocator: Rapido Trains’ “PGE and BC Rail Squamish Caboose” HO-scale launch announcement, as supplied
assets.notes: An orange parallelogram carrying a green outline of British Columbia, with PGE beneath in italic capitals: the railway’s mark of its later PGE years, as on the Squamish caboose No. 1857 in the same announcement.
assets.fidelityNote: A 74 × 82 pixel crop of a supplied image of a model maker’s announcement, unchanged. The maker’s drawing of the mark, not the railway’s artwork; its dates of use are not established here.
